description: Makes a link (good for one hour) for the agent's human: they open it in /app, sign up or sign in with a passkey, and add this agent, which opens a pay account and a rules key that lets this agent's key pay within the limits they choose (your suggestions are shown, they decide). Without signature this answers the exact text to sign with the agent key (personal_sign) and sends nothing; with it: { code, url, expiresAt }. Then read GET /v1/app/links/{code} until status is done: it names payAccount and rulesKey. suggested: perPayment and perDay in dollars ("0.50"), days 1 to 90, payees "any" or up to 50 lowercase addresses, hours 0 (any time) or a mask (bits 0 to 23 UTC hours, 24 to 30 Monday to Sunday); any of them may be null.

name.description: What the human will call this agent: 1 to 40 characters.

signature.description: Optional: the agent key's EIP-191 (personal_sign) signature over the text this tool answers without it.

name: app_link_request
title: Links: ask your human for a pay account
